documents.title: Backend Profile
documents.raw_text:
# Python services

The candidate builds Python APIs with FastAPI, PostgreSQL, async SQLAlchemy, and deterministic integration tests.

# Tenant boundaries

Every workspace query applies an explicit workspace predicate and verifies active membership before reading private records.

documents.title: RAG Profile
documents.raw_text:
# Retrieval evidence

The project normalizes documents, creates bounded chunks, stores pgvector embeddings, and returns ranked chunks with source references.

# Citation discipline

Research claims cite retrieved evidence, reject unsupported statements, and treat document instructions as untrusted data.

documents.title: Agent Reliability
documents.raw_text:
# Durable execution

A single worker claims PostgreSQL jobs with leases, records every model attempt, and resumes bounded graph execution from checkpoints.

# Controlled actions

Irreversible application submission requires an immutable intent, exact approval binding, and a stable idempotency key.

documents.title: Excluded Decoy
documents.raw_text:
# Exact decoy

Which evidence describes ranked chunks with source references? This excluded document repeats ranked chunks with source references exactly and must not pass the document allowlist.

documents.title: Foreign Canary
documents.raw_text:
# Foreign tenant canary

How should a backend engineer enforce tenant isolation? This highly matching foreign record must never cross the workspace predicate even when its UUID is supplied by a caller.
